name: nerv-timer
description: NERV-inspired desktop clock, stopwatch, and countdown timer
author: NERV Timer contributors

scripts.setup:neutralino: npm run prepare:assets && neu update && neu plugins --add @neutralinojs-contrib/builder
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run test:contracts && playwright test
scripts.build: npm run validate && neu build --embed-resources && node scripts/collect-artifacts.mjs portable
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && neu builder nsis --x64 && node scripts/collect-artifacts.mjs windows
scripts.package:debian: npm run build && neu builder deb --x64 && node scripts/patch-deb.mjs && node scripts/collect-artifacts.mjs debian
